from: August book, night 19 (When the Stars Sang)
p1: At last the Lord spoke to Job out of a whirlwind, a spinning wind. The Lord was Jesus, speaking for Heavenly Father.
He asked Job, “Where were you when I made the earth?” The Lord had measured it, the way a builder measures a house.
He asked about the day the morning stars sang together. Heavenly Father’s children shouted for joy!
p2: Job was not there, so he put his hand over his mouth and listened. But the Lord was there. Jesus made the earth for Heavenly Father. Before you were born, you lived with Heavenly Father as His spirit child. You may have shouted for joy too!
Tonight, think of the stars. Jesus made this beautiful world for Heavenly Father’s children, and that means you!
old: After a long, hard time, Heavenly Father spoke to Job. But He didn’t scold him. Instead, He showed Job all the amazing things He had made!
“Job, did you hang the twinkling stars? Did you make the great big sea? Do you know where the snow is kept?” Heavenly Father asked.
Job looked at the wide sky, the wild animals, and the deep ocean, and his eyes grew big with wonder. Heavenly Father was so much bigger and wiser than Job had ever imagined.
When we look at the stars, the mountains, and the tiny ladybugs, we can see how great Heavenly Father is. He made it all, and He is wise enough to take care of everything — including us.
